title: Persistence V1 inventory

sqlite.reason: No proven relational query, join, multi-table transaction, or concurrent writer requirement exists in the inventoried canonical product/recovery stores.
sqlite.rule: Do not introduce SQLite unless a later checkpoint proves a concrete relational or concurrency requirement that atomic versioned JSON cannot satisfy safely.

durable_product_stores.path: $XDG_STATE_HOME/VideoBatchFast/projects/*.vbfast.json (default); arbitrary user-selected filesystem paths are also supported by open/save-as
durable_product_stores.purpose: User project state, media paths, output settings, slideshow/calendar/layout project data
durable_product_stores.path_boundary: Default XDG project directory plus any explicit user-selected project file path.

durable_product_stores.purpose: Durable failed/not-started jobs for explicit retry

load_protection: primary recoverable_batches reader currently accepts any JSON object without enforcing schema_version
durable_product_stores.purpose: Crash/power-loss durable batch operation state and recovery history
durable_product_stores.known_limitation: Canonical recovery can consume active journal objects without a schema-version gate; a future integrity checkpoint should cover this explicitly.

durable_product_stores.writer: atomic_write_json; exclusive target reservation; verified publish/remove transaction flow
load_protection: target size/hash verification before source removal
recover_archive_transactions classifies unfinished transactions without deleting source data
terminal transaction states are retained as durable evidence
durable_product_stores.purpose: Verified archival/publication transaction state and manifest for original media moved into the project archive

load_protection: approval identity includes version, payload hash, signing key, capability and permission fingerprint
durable_product_stores.purpose: Security-relevant durable plugin approval, revocation and expiry state

operational_json_not_core_database.purpose: Bounded long-render rehearsal state/evidence; not canonical user data

findings: Canonical persistence is centered on safe_io.atomic_write_json, with additional transaction-specific durability around archive publication and job journals.
Durable persistence boundaries include project state, config, retry queue, batch journals, archive transactions/manifests and plugin approvals.
Project files are not restricted to the default XDG directory; explicit user-selected paths are canonical persistence locations too.
The primary job-journal recovery reader currently lacks an explicit schema_version gate; only the consistency inspector enforces schema 2.
Operational startup/evidence JSON must remain separate from user/recovery persistence.
No SQLite migration is justified by the inventoried requirements.
CP-04 inventory does not authorize product persistence refactors.
next_checkpoint_candidate: Add focused persistence architecture guards and integrity tests for all inventoried durable stores without changing storage technology.
